summary: Roku filed an Item 8.01 8-K supplementing the joint proxy/prospectus for its pending acquisition by Fox Corporation under a June 14, 2026 Agreement and Plan of Merger, structured as a two-step reverse triangular merger in which Roku becomes a wholly owned Fox subsidiary and then merges into Merger Sub 2. The supplement responds to stockholder demand letters alleging disclosure omissions in the S-4 (effective September 1, 2026), providing voluntary corrective disclosures without admission of merit. No deal terms, price, premium, advisor, or closing date are restated in the excerpt; watch the Roku special meeting vote and any further litigation-driven disclosure demands for timing risk.
